events.summary: Hi everyone!It's been a while since my last update so I wanted to take some time to share with everyone how things have been going and what you can expect in the very near future.Development is moving full steam ahead, and I'm excited to say that many of the core systems planned for the 1.0 release are now implemented or nearing completion. events.title: Demo Update: Straight Into Survival
events.summary: Hi everyone,Just wanted to share a quick demo update with you all! The new version now starts with a short scene in the city where you fight to escape as zombies break into a house. It gives you a clearer feel for the danger outside the camp and lets you experience what happened before waking up in the infirmary. Once that moment plays out, the demo continues as it always has, but now with a stronger and more engaging introduction to the world of Ashfield Hollow.Happy surviving!
